step.label: Validate bill of materials compliance
step.description: Ensure all product components meet regulatory and engineering standards before manufacturing begins.
step.useCase: Engineering team confirms new product revision has compliant materials and components.

step.label: Retrieve procurement and vendor specifications
step.description: Obtain current material sourcing options and certified vendor data to support BOM validation outcomes.
step.useCase: Procurement specialist accesses approved material suppliers and pricing for validated BOM items.

step.label: Monitor workplace hazards in production materials
step.description: Identify any hazardous substances or safety risks associated with materials scheduled for production.
step.useCase: Safety officer reviews hazard alerts for materials in the approved BOM before shop-floor release.

step.label: Orchestrate asset and resource provisioning
step.description: Coordinate allocation of manufacturing equipment, tools, and infrastructure needed to execute the production plan with validated materials.
step.useCase: Operations manager confirms machines and production orders are allocated and ready for the new product run.

step.label: Plan workforce capacity and skill allocation
step.description: Determine staffing levels and assign personnel with appropriate skills and availability to execute production safely and efficiently.
step.useCase: HR planning team maps production order requirements to available machine operators and technicians.

step.label: Verify employee safety certifications and training
step.description: Confirm that assigned production staff hold current safety certifications and have completed required material-handling training.
step.useCase: Safety coordinator validates that each shift operator has active hazmat and equipment certifications.

step.label: Coordinate compensation adjustments for hazard duty
step.description: Apply appropriate pay grades and hazard allowances for personnel assigned to handle restricted or dangerous materials.
step.useCase: Payroll specialist ensures workers on hazardous material production receive appropriate hazard pay premiums.

step.label: Analyze procurement and safety metrics for process improvement
step.description: Review invoice, material cost, and incident data to identify cost-saving opportunities and safety trends across the production cycle.
step.useCase: Finance and safety teams use procurement and incident analytics to optimize future production planning and vendor selection.
